name: LIFT Model
description: A conversion-optimisation framework that evaluates a web page through six factors: value proposition, relevance, clarity, anxiety, distraction and urgency. Used to generate hypotheses for A/B tests.
design_relevance_note: A review checklist for landing pages, product pages and checkout flows; its output is a set of test hypotheses, not findings.
myth_risk_note: A vendor-originated framework presented with the vocabulary of a model; there is no independent evidence about whether using it improves test outcomes.
prevalence_note: Common in CRO agencies; little visibility outside them.
